entries.title: Authenticate first, then fetch order details and variant.
entries.lesson: Authenticate first, then fetch order details and variant availability, present the best-match plus fallback options, and require explicit confirmation of replacement item_ids and payment method before submitting the exchange.
entries.retrieval_text:
Title: Authenticate first, then fetch order details and variant.
Applicability: when handling similar exchange_modify cases
Lesson: Authenticate first, then fetch order details and variant availability, present the best-match plus fallback options, and require explicit confirmation of replacement item_ids and payment method before submitting the exchange.
Family: exchange_modify
Outcome: success

entries.title: Authenticate first, then verify order eligibility and variant.
entries.lesson: Authenticate first, then verify order eligibility and variant availability; when user provides conditional preferences, explicitly apply the fallback based on inventory and confirm the final exchange plus payment method before submitting.

entries.title: When the user can’t recall the order email.
entries.lesson: When the user can’t recall the order email, use name+ZIP to resolve the account, then confirm exact item_ids and refund method before submitting returns; for inventory questions, count only in‑stock (available=true) variants.
